ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.quote: Carry, mid and offlane held favorable matchups while jungle fought Kwang's edge all game. An early solo death gave them first blood, but the team's objective control erased that deficit. The team kept winning fights without converting next to them, twice taking a fight clean and still losing the tower or ceding Fangtooth in the same window. A full five-on-five at Fangtooth, five kills to one, was the night's cleanest moment, and objective damage finished nearly five times theirs.
ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.issue: sim-lane read stated as a sustained fact ('all game') and undercounts the won-fight-but-lost-objective pattern as 'twice' when the facts show three instances (17.7m tower, 19.6m Fangtooth, 21.7m tower)
ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.rewrite: Carry, mid and offlane held favorable matchups while jungle faced a tougher matchup against Kwang. An early solo death gave them first blood, but the team's objective control erased that deficit. The team kept winning fights without converting next to them, three times taking a fight clean and still losing the tower or ceding Fangtooth in the same window. A full five-on-five at Fangtooth, five kills to one, was the night's cleanest moment, and objective damage finished nearly five times theirs.
